# VS Code extension — STATUS

**READY (working, unpublished).** Two commands, both real: "OHAM:
Inspect .tsb" (structure panel from `info --json`) and "OHAM: Preview
Frame" (exact L1 decode to a webview image). Needs the oham binary on
PATH or `oham.binaryPath` set. Publishing to the Marketplace needs the
owner: a publisher account (`paul-phillips` assumed in package.json —
change if different) + `vsce publish` with a marketplace PAT. Next
iteration: the pan/zoom still viewer (web/still.html) as a custom
editor for .tsb.
